verdict.rationale: Fathom's own pages describe in-product AI output generated from meeting data: instant AI summaries, custom summaries, AI-generated action items, a Deal View that summarizes insights, AI coaching scorecards, automatic topic monitoring, and a conversational meeting assistant. Together these cover both the insights and the suggestions in the story. All of this comes from short pricing and marketing lines rather than detailed documentation, which keeps confidence at medium. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration of their quality.
